comments.body:
**Summary of work on this proof task.**

I reviewed the existing solution to Problem 4 (superadditivity of $1/\Phi_n$ under finite free convolution) and found that, while honest in tone, it contained an **invalid pseudo-reduction**: the old Proposition (status) claimed an MSS Hilbert-space realisation $(H,P,\xi,\eta)$ satisfying the abstract Stam-reduction hypotheses, in particular item (I) that $\mathbb E_Q\|\xi(Q)\|^2=\Phi_n(p)$. This is **false**: with $\xi(Q)=\mathrm{score}(\mathrm{eig}(M_Q))$ one gets $\mathbb E_Q\Phi_n(M_Q)$, which equals neither $\Phi_n(p)$, $\Phi_n(q)$, nor their sum (verified numerically; e.g. random centred $n=3$ pair gives $\mathbb E_Q\Phi_n(M_Q)\approx 91.1$ vs $\Phi_n(p)\approx 8.55$, $\Phi_n(q)\approx 314$). So the general case was *not* actually reduced to anything elementary.

**Changes made (all numerically verified):**
1. Added an explicit "Honest status summary" delimiting proved vs. open.
2. Tightened the fully-rigorous parts (structural lemmas, score formula, variational form, $n=2$ exact additivity, degenerate/equality cases).
3. New Lemma (T_eps flow): proved $T_\varepsilon p = p\boxplus_n \ell_\varepsilon$ with $\ell_\varepsilon=(1-\varepsilon D)^n x^n=(-\varepsilon)^n n!\,L_n^{(0)}(x/\varepsilon)$ real-rooted (symbolic check $n\le4$; real-rootedness $n\le8$), and $T_\varepsilon$ commutes with $\boxplus_n$.
4. Rewrote Prop. (reductions)(c) into a clean correct continuity argument; recorded that $r=p\boxplus_n q$ is always real-rooted (MSS).
5. Replaced the invalid pseudo-reduction with an honest section: keeps the correct abstract Stam reduction lemma and the Jacobi formulas (both fully proved), then explains precisely why the naive MSS realisation fails all three hypotheses (false norm identity; signed averaging weight $D_Q(\rho)/r'(\rho)$ obstructing contractivity; non-vanishing finite-$n$ cross moments).

**Honest outcome:** $(\star)$ is proved with equality for $n=2$ and in all degenerate cases; for $n\ge3$ it remains **open** in this writeup (decisive numerics for all $n\le8$). I did not fabricate a proof of the hard general case. Setting status to **in_progress**.
